subject.title: Fix subagent announce restart recovery cascade

question: Should PR #97932 land with `announceLastRun` persisted state and `status: "killed"` reconciliation for interrupted announce turns after the hosted lint failure is resolved?
rationale: Automation can verify that the current patch covers the inspected code paths, but choosing the durable session-state meaning and non-running status for aborted announce delivery turns is an owner-level compatibility decision.

options.title: Approve Current Recovery Shape
options.body: Land after `check-lint` is rerun or resolved, keeping `announceLastRun` plus `status: "killed"` reconciliation as the canonical announce-interruption behavior.

options.title: Require A Different Terminal State
options.body: Ask the author to use a different non-running status or marker if `killed` should remain reserved for true aborted human/model work.

options.title: Pause For Typed Run-Kind Design
options.body: Defer this PR if maintainers want a broader typed human-vs-delivery run model before adding another persisted session marker.

recommendation.title: Approve Current Recovery Shape
recommendation.body: Land after `check-lint` is rerun or resolved, keeping `announceLastRun` plus `status: "killed"` reconciliation as the canonical announce-interruption behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: jalehman introduced the restart recovery lifecycle seam and is the strongest history match for deciding the durable recovery state semantics.
